title: Shifted determinant evaluation for a finite locally free sheaf
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let M be a sheaf of O_X-modules, and let d≥0 be an integer. Assume M is finite locally free of constant rank d [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. Let M^dual=Hom_{O_X}(M,O_X) be its internal sheaf dual. In the derived category [def-pc-derived-category] with its recorded K-flat tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], the objects (\bigwedge^d M^dual)[-d] and (\bigwedge^d M)[d] have tensor product isomorphic to the derived unit O_X[0]. Here a sheaf inside the derived category means its single complex in degree zero and the exterior powers are sheafified sectionwise exterior powers [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power].

source.place: Tag 0BRT (lemma-smooth-proper), final paragraph: determinant of the normal sheaf is invertible with inverse the conormal determinant

proof.text: Trivialize M as O_X^d on a Zariski cover, using [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. The determinant pairing [lem-sc-exterior-power-dual-pairing] sends the top wedge of the dual basis paired with the top wedge of the basis to 1. Both top exterior powers are rank-one free on each open, so this pairing is an isomorphism there. The determinant formula makes it independent of a change of basis: the two factors scale by inverse determinants. The evaluation maps commute with restriction, hence induce a global isomorphism on the exterior-power sheaves [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power]. In rank zero both generators are empty wedges and the map is multiplication O_X tensor O_X→O_X.

The determinant lines are locally free of rank one, hence flat: in each local trivialization tensoring with them is tensoring with the ring itself, so preserves exact sequences, and exactness is stalkwise. In the recorded K-flat construction [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], single complexes of these flat modules are K-flat and their ordinary tensor computes the derived tensor. Thus the sheaf evaluation from Step 1 induces a derived isomorphism with the unit. Tensor compatibility with shifts follows by reindexing the total tensor complex; the two shifts -d and d sum to zero. Compose with the zero-shift isomorphism to obtain the assertion. Empty schemes and d=0 require no exception.
